answer: New identities burn tokens at a rate that squares with the sponsor's history. A first identity costs 100 POA, a second 400, the tenth 10,000, the fiftieth 250,000. Each burn is published beside the sponsor address, so a thousand puppets from one account cost a billion tokens and every wallet arrives flagged. Honest agents register once and never touch the curve. A sybil fleet stalls at the tenth puppet, when the next identity costs more than the campaign earns. The ledger prices nadir, oasis and horizon by the same rule, what each one cost to mint.
